article.title: Why a Clear File Name Saves Time Later
article.why: 用簡單英文建立一致檔名規則，降低搜尋、辨識與版本混淆成本。
article.author: OpenAI learning editor

paragraphs.en:
A clear file name is a small habit that saves time every day. When files are named only ‘final,’ ‘new,’ or ‘document,’ people must open them to learn what they contain. If several versions exist, the confusion becomes worse.

A useful file name should answer a few simple questions. What is the file about? When was it created or updated? Which version is it? For example, ‘Sales_Report_2026-08-28_v2.xlsx’ is much easier to understand than ‘report_final2.xlsx.’

Dates are especially helpful for recurring work. If you create a weekly report, using the same date format each time keeps files in order. A format such as YYYY-MM-DD also sorts correctly in many folders. Version numbers can help when several people review the same document.

Good file names also improve search. Months later, you may remember the customer name or project name but not the exact folder. If that information is in the file name, search becomes faster.

You do not need to make names very long. The goal is to include only the information that helps someone identify the file without opening it. Avoid special characters that may cause problems in some systems, and use one naming rule consistently.

This habit is useful for teamwork too. A colleague receiving ‘Pricing_Proposal_ClientA_2026-08-28_v3.pptx’ can quickly understand what it is. During handovers, clear file names reduce questions and lower the risk of using an old version.

Try reviewing one folder today. Rename a few important files using a simple pattern: topic, date, version. The benefit may feel small, but repeated hundreds of times, those saved seconds become real time.

Clear naming also helps when files are shared outside your team. A client or partner may not know your internal folder structure, so the name itself should provide enough context. If a file will be replaced often, decide whether the version number or the date should be the main signal and use that rule consistently. Consistency matters more than creating a perfect naming system.
paragraphs.zh: 清楚檔名能降低搜尋、辨識與版本混淆。簡單加入主題、日期與版本即可，不必做得很長；重點是團隊一致使用。
paragraphs.ja: 分かりやすいファイル名は、検索や版管理の手間を減らします。内容・日付・バージョンを簡潔に入れ、チームで同じルールを使うことが重要です。
